q: Water boils at 100°C at standard pressure. True or False?
e: At 1 atmosphere (101.325 kPa), water boils at exactly 100°C. This is the standard definition of the Celsius scale.

q: What is the chemical symbol for Gold?
e: Au comes from the Latin word aurum, meaning shining dawn. Ag is Silver, Fe is Iron, Pb is Lead.
